qualification: Repository workflow criteria; no licensed allowable is reproduced or inferred.

source_qualification.requirement: Every input retains its declared source or its assumed, based on previous experience qualification; a generic assumption does not qualify an installation design.

geometry.requirement: Read back both endpoint positions, contact order, exit angle, curvature and every roller reaction. Reconcile them with the generated separated endpoints and attached supports before comparison.

force_balance.requirement: Retain endpoint forces, submerged weight and all support reactions in a common global frame; report the resultant force residual and its normalization. A native acceptance tolerance is not established.

native_convergence.requirement: Retain convergence diagnostics and saved native state, reopen it and read back the required quantities. A process exit or a preparation result alone is insufficient.

mesh_convergence.requirement: Compare tension, bending moment, curvature, touchdown and roller reactions across refined meshes before acceptance; refinement levels and allowable changes are not established.

catenary_relative_tolerance.requirement: Use measured stinger-exit height and effective tension at the same endpoint for the independent free-span comparator. Report residuals; native agreement tolerance is not established.

overbend_strain_limit.requirement: D/(2R) is a circular bending-strain screen, not an allowable. No sourced design strain limit is available in this preparation basis.

basis.title: DNV-ST-F101, simplified laying criteria
basis.concrete_crushing: Concrete coating crushing requires a qualified coating strength and support contact-pressure basis; these inputs are not established.
basis.qualification: S2 installation design acceptance remains not established; no licensed allowable is reproduced.

installation_acceptance.requirement: Acceptance requires versioned allowables, comparator tolerances, mesh convergence and reconciliation of every applicable case. Null tolerances and generic assumptions cannot produce an accepted design.

stinger_conformity.requirement: S1: maximum overbend strain <= 1.10*D/(2R) and zero static force on the last stinger support. D/(2R) is a screen.
